# audit — LLM doc index (pinned: v0.9.1)
# One line per file; regenerate the pin on release.
docs/index.md: the map of this bundle
docs/overview.md: why one shared emitter and schema, and how a record flows to krateo_audit
docs/schema.md: the record contract, key by key, per writer class (generated from schema/v1.yaml)
docs/coverage.md: the cross-component audit inventory (AUDIT-4): one row per mutating path per component, in one table per writer class
docs/usage.md: install, when to emit, the actor, adopting v0.4, v0.5, v0.6, v0.7, v0.8 and v0.9, testing a writer, the live check
docs/configuration.md: the Emitter's options and metrics, and the OTel Logs SDK setup
docs/api.md: the Go API, audittest and cmd/auditschema
docs/examples.md: examples index
docs/release.md: tag-only release runbook (v-prefixed git tags, Go module proxy)
docs/log.md: curated history
schema/v1.yaml: THE schema, the source of the constants, the checker and docs/schema.md
audit.go: the emitter
check.go: the checker
content.go: the content hash canonicaliser (ContentSHA256)
client.go: the client-asserted provenance (ClientProvenance)
schema.go: the schema types and accessors
schema_gen.go: generated from schema/v1.yaml
coverage_test.go: the check that every docs/coverage.md row meets audit#9's acceptance and names a real population, falsifier included
contract_records_test.go: the example records docs/schema.md shows (kept deletion, pruned child), emitted and checked
testdata/v0.4.0/: records audit v0.4.0 emitted, and v0.4.0's check report on them (the compatibility arm)
testdata/v0.5.0/: records audit v0.5.0 emitted (generated by its gen/ module on v0.5.0), and v0.5.0's check report on them
testdata/v0.8.0/: records audit v0.8.0 emitted (generated by its gen/ module on v0.8.0), and v0.8.0's check report on them
sanitize.go: the UTF-8 sanitiser
claim.go: the principal claim parser
legacy.go: the W1 dual-write
recorded.go: the krateo.audit.recorded span marker for the tail sampler
audittest/audittest.go: helpers for a writer's conformance tests, falsifier included
cmd/auditschema/main.go: the checker for non-Go writers, and the live conformance SQL
internal/schemagen/main.go: the generator
examples/emit-to-stdout/README.md: runnable example emitting one record to stdout
examples/emit-to-stdout/main.go: the example source
